comment: World (i) of the families round, matter alone (HIGHLIGHTS.md, Every family run on the engine and seen to work; the advisor's blinds, #1563 comment 5928483084; ALGEBRA.md, The bound body is one Node, The two branches, row (s), row (u), row (w)): one body of the matter family at rest on the rule's own universe (examples/events/rule.json: gravity at the level weight 1,000, the charge at 1, the binding holder [2400, 2401] at 1, matter [4000, 6000]), on an open box (every axis open with the faces' layer one Node deep: a board periodic on every axis has no rest), laid by the generator (tools/pixel_mode.py) as its standing record in the wells its own form lays, declared with one Node carrying its quanta in the engine's count (ALGEBRA.md, The count's unit: the engine's count is about three times the advisor's vacuum share along the compact branch, 3.7 at the Node and 3.1 in all at 2,000). Two worlds: `pixel`, the compact branch, `quanta` quanta on the box of `shape` (the generator reaches the compact pixel at this count, 9,451 quanta at the centre Node with a tail of a few Links; at 8,000 and at 7,000 on the same box it reaches the wide branch, a body of rms radius 3.9 Links with about 50 quanta at the centre, and at 4,500 it refuses the body by name as a cloud, its standing rotation under the band's top (every lay named here is the generator's on main 3fe40aeb's engine, before the self-read round, whose rest differs: every held row reads the content at the Node's pace, and bodies above 2 / 27 of content have no rest; the worlds are laid anew by the builder, with --modes, on the finished engine, and no world laid on the old engine is committed)), and `cloud`, the wide branch, the advisor's cloud of 4,000 quanta on the 41-cube (row (w): the generator's own start is the shape of the body's well; the wide start b_i = exp(-r_i / R_0) with R_0 = 2 Gamma / C is not the generator's, so the generator refuses this body by name as a cloud, which the build prints: the lay of this folder read 'the body of 4000 quanta about the Node [20, 20, 20] is a cloud: its standing reading rotates at [932, 701], not above the band's top 2 x 4000 / 6000 and below 2', 1.3295 against the top 1.3333 and the advisor's 1.351; the world file stands declared without a mode file, the loader refusing it at load until the generator lays the wide branch from the wide start, R_0 = 2 Gamma / C Links, the line row (w) names). Headless, `ticks` intervals, the reading at the window's ends by tools/body_rest.py, a GameBoard reading and no click. The run is not performed in the round that prepares it: the families round runs once on the finished engine (the owner, 2026-10-01, 13:00 and 17:10).
reading: per world (tools/body_rest.py, GameBoard): at the window's ends the body's three levels about one interval at its centre and their ratio (next + before) / now = 2 cos omega_b, its quanta at the centre Node and over the board, the centroid of its share and the second moment about it (the rms radius squared), its well over the board (D summed over T), its record's levels along each axis from the centre with the ratios of successive levels (e^(-kappa) per Link on the tail), every held row's level along the same axes, and the books (the share's drift from the lay).
